title: Cross-System Goal Overlap Duplicates
dataSources: Habit activity (`lifeos:habit`), streaks (`lifeos:streak`), Beeminder goals (`lifeos:beeminder`), OKRs (`lifeos:okr`), planning syncs (`lifeos:ops`).
app: Personal life-OS telemetry — Habitica quest logs, Streaks app habit chains, Beeminder goal data, and personal OKR reviews — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:ops system_name=* overlap_resolved=*
| stats sum(eval(if(overlap_resolved="no",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by system_name
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending duplicate goals backlog by system for cross-system goal hygiene.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside cross-system goal hygiene.
implementation: Mark each `lifeos:ops` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `system_name`.
visualization: Table of system with pending duplicate goals counts.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals where unfinished duplicate goals are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in cross-system goal hygiene.
